q: Why mix real inputs with synthetic cases?
options: Synthetic cases skew toward document-like phrasing and flatter systems built on the same documents
explain: Real inputs keep the set honest.

q: What does a coverage grid with empty cells tell you?
options: Some slices have no cases, so regressions there go unnoticed
explain: Fill gaps with expert-written or filtered synthetic cases.

q: Why keep a held-out set you never tune on?
options: Tuning on the reporting set makes its score stop measuring generalization
explain: Contamination by tuning is still contamination.
